title: Velvety British Cheese Gratin
description: A rich and creamy British dish featuring stale bread and a blend of cheeses, perfect for a date night, with a dairy-free friendly option. It has a nice mustardy flavor and a cheese-pull effect.

ingredients.name: stale bread
ingredients.notes: dried out in a low oven

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the dried out bread into 1 inch cubes and set aside.
In a large skillet, saute the onion and garlic until softened.
In a large bowl, combine the bread, sauteed onion and garlic, dairy-free cheese shreds, nutritional yeast, whole grain mustard, salt, black pepper, and fresh thyme.
Mix well until all the ingredients are fully incorporated.
Transfer the mixture to a donabe or a large baking dish.
Dot the top of the mixture with vegan butter.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
